title: wgsextract.report/1
description: A sample's personal report: what earlier wgsextract runs found, by section, each finding with a confidence label, its evidence and the 'technical result, not diagnosis' disclaimer. Written by `wgsextract report` as <sample>_personal_report.json. See docs/personal-report.md.

name.description: The sample's name: its alignment's (or VCF's) file name without extensions.

folder.description: The sample folder's name (not its full path). Every file path in the report is relative to this folder.

alignment.description: The BAM/CRAM the report describes, relative to the folder.

vcf.description: The sample's VCF used in hints, relative to the folder.

workspace.description: The sample workspace file, when there is one.

all_calls.description: Every carried ClinVar P/LP call (confidence TSV), relative to the folder.

all_conflicts.description: Conflicting ClinVar assertions for review, not consensus P/LP, relative to the folder.

genes.description: Each listed gene with P/LP calls, counted by zygosity.

inheritance.description: The gene list's mode of inheritance (AD, AR, SD, XL); null when it gives none.

hemizygous.description: Haploid calls (one allele in the genotype).

partial.description: Calls whose other allele was not called (1/.).

phase.description: The phase of two or more heterozygous calls: trans when two are on opposite copies (two ALTs of one call such as 1/2, or phased in one phase set), cis when all are phased on one copy in one phase set, else unknown (unphased, phased without a PS, or in different phase sets). Null for fewer than two, and when the calls are incomplete (calls_truncated) unless trans.

confidence.description: The weakest confidence label of the gene's calls.

status.description: For a gene the list reports only when biallelic (AR): biallelic (a homozygous call, or two heterozygous calls in trans), possible_biallelic (two or more heterozygous calls not all phased together, or a hemizygous or partly called genotype) or carrier (one heterozygous call, or several in cis). Null for other genes, and when the calls are incomplete (calls_truncated) unless biallelic.

status_text.description: The status explained; empty when status is null.

acmg_research.description: fastVEP's automated ACMG/AMP classes (vcf acmg), research use only and not a diagnosis. Present only when vcf acmg ran.

disclaimer.description: The research-only disclaimer, shown at the top of the section.

tool.description: The classifier and its version, e.g. 'fastVEP 0.5.0'.

criteria_not_evaluated.description: ACMG/AMP criteria the classifier never evaluated.

all_calls.description: The classified VCF (acmg_annotated.vcf.gz), relative to the folder.

counts.description: Carried alleles by automated class (p, lp, vus, lb, b), and the carried P/LP calls in_gene_list (the findings), outside_gene_list and unplaced.

all_svs.description: Every SV with its frequency class (sv_freq.tsv), relative to the folder.

counts.description: Carried SVs by frequency class (common, low, rare, novel), and listed: the rare SVs shown as findings.

id.description: A built-in list's id (acmg-sf-3.3), or the name of the user's TSV or BED file.

url.description: The published gene table a built-in list was checked against; empty for a user's file.

status.description: ok: at least one source run succeeded; not_run: no run found (see missing); failed: only failed runs found (see error).

missing.description: Parts of the section not run yet, with the command that produces each (relative to the sample folder).

sources.description: The result manifests the section was built from: the selected evidence's status and finish time, and the newest attempt when that is newer.
